facts.text: Rules are rules. No business on these grounds, Mr. Wick, but the bar is open and the room is yours.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Winston's words, but he never says it. His real lines on the quote page include 'I know what you're thinking, Jonathan. We live by a code.' and the line revoking Ms. Perkins' membership.
facts.fix: "I know what you're thinking, Jonathan. We live by a code."

facts.text: Viggo's drink while telling the Baba Yaga story.
facts.why: Viggo tells Iosef that John is Baba Yaga, but no source or transcript line shows him drinking in that scene, and vodka is never mentioned.
facts.fix: Raised to Viggo, who tells Iosef who he crossed.

facts.text: Serve the drinks when John sits at the bar in the Continental.
facts.why: John lodges at the Continental and talks to Winston there. Plausible, though the plot sources do not say the talk happens at the bar.

facts.text: Ask Charlie about a dinner reservation for twelve.
facts.why: Nod to the cleaners' code after John kills Viggo's hit squad at his house. Plainly a reference, though the code line is from memory of the film, not the pages opened.

vibe.verdict: The hotel layout suits the Continental and the winks hit the right marks, with food that is a bit generic.
